name: Cordelia Glauca
original_name: コーデリア・グラウカ
source:
A member of "Milky Holmes".

Cordelia is a blonde girl who often gets delusions concerning the relationships within the group. She tends to get rather out of control whenever she is scared, particularly of the dark. Her Toys allows her to see and hear things others cannot. 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tantei_Opera_Milky_Holmes#Milky_Holmes]Wikipedia[/url]]
